subject: Northshore - C-suite signoff requested for liability cap + indemnity carveouts and pilot discount
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@northshorehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@northshorehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Revised redlines + pilot commercial proposal

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached are our proposed redlines (Northshore_Redlines_v3.docx); two items at the top of the deck we need to resolve before procurement will sign:

- Liability cap: we need an increase to $5,000,000 (company policy requires 3x projection for pilot exposures).
- Indemnity: carveouts requested for data processing claims tied to our customers' PHI flows.
- Commercial: looking for a 25% introductory discount for a 12-month pilot (annualized).

We'd like to close by mid‑June if possible. Please confirm next steps and whether any of the redlines will require internal escalation.

Attachments: Northshore_Redlines_v3.docx (track-changes enabled)

Best,
Sam Patel
VP Procurement, Northshore Health Systems
sam.patel@northshorehealth.com
Phone: +1 (617) 555-0183

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@northshorehealth.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@northshorehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revised redlines + pilot commercial proposal

Team — looping you in. Key asks from Northshore (summary):
- Liability cap increase to $5M
- Indemnity carveouts for PHI-related claims
- 25% pilot discount for 12 months

Irene: can you weigh in on the indemnity and cap asks? This is a strategic health system in our target vertical; Ben thinks pilot -> expansion potential is strong. If legal recommends escalation, please flag the approver level and a suggested commercial offset.

Ben: can you propose a reduced concession we can ask execs to approve (e.g., lower cap but larger discount / payment terms)?

Timeline: customer wants signature mid-June, procurement is pushing. I attached the customer's redlines for reference.

Attachments: Northshore_Redlines_v3.docx (from customer)

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0122

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revised redlines + pilot commercial proposal

Grace / team — quick legal read and recommended path: 

Inline summary of material redlines (from Northshore_Redlines_v3.docx):
1) Liability cap: customer requests $5M across all claims. Our standard cap for pilot customers is $1M (or 2x ARR, whichever is lower). Raising to $5M materially increases residual risk.
2) Indemnity carveouts for PHI: customer is seeking to exclude consequential damages and to limit indemnity in ways that would leave us exposed for third‑party PHI claims.
3) Warranty language: they want broad warranty disclaimers removed. We should keep as-is with a short-term SLAs exception.

Recommended counter / escalation ask:
- Approve temporary cap of $2,000,000 for the 12‑month pilot (subject to execution of a mutually agreed SOW and security attestations).
- Indemnity: accept limited data processing carveout tied to subcontractor activities only; insist on indemnity for Redwood willful misconduct and third‑party IP infringement.
- Pricing concession: counter 20% pilot discount instead of 25%, but require committed renewal terms on expansion.

Rationale: this balances commercial urgency and risk management for an important customer. Because the requested cap exceeds our delegated approval thresholds, this requires C‑suite signoff (Aditya or CFO) and a short memo for the Exec Risk Committee. I can draft the memo if someone confirms approval path.

Attachments: Legal_Summary_Northshore.pdf (two pages)

—Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@northshorehealth.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@northshorehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revised redlines + pilot commercial proposal

Aditya — quick note to request C-suite authorization. Customer is strategic and there is a clear path to enterprise expansion if we close now. Proposed one-time approvals to enable signature this quarter: 

- Liability cap: $2,000,000 for the 12‑month pilot (per Irene's recommendation)
- Indemnity: limited carveout as drafted by Irene; Redwood indemnifies for willful misconduct and IP infringement
- Commercial: 20% introductory discount, 30‑day payment terms, and a three‑month SLA credit provision (standard language)

If we get greenlight on the cap/indemnity above, I will push DocuSign and lock the pilot. HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/ND-2027-045. SOW draft attached.

Attachments: SOW_Northshore_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0166

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@northshorehealth.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@northshorehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revised redlines + pilot commercial proposal — C-suite signoff (conditional)

Appreciate the succinct summary. I will approve the exception on the following conditions: 

1) Liability cap: approved at $2,000,000 for the 12‑month pilot only. No precedent to be set for enterprise contracts — we will annotate in the RBAC log.
2) Indemnity: accept Irene's limited carveout but we must retain indemnity for Redwood's willful misconduct and IP infringement; add standard security attestation appendices.
3) Commercial: approve a one-time pilot discount of 15% (not 20%); Ben — aim to recover via committed expansion terms (recommended: 12‑month minimum renewal at list + standard growth incentives).
4) SLA: include a credit cap equal to the liability cap relative to SLA breaches (legal to confirm language).
5) Execution: approval contingent on customer signing by 2027‑06‑10 and completion of the security checklist.

Ben/Grace — proceed to finalize the SOW and push the DocuSign packet. I am copying them so procurement is aware. DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/accelerate/ND-2027-045

Aditya Rao
CEO, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
